description: Japan Electric Power Exchange market data is a data repository run by Japan Electric Power Exchange (JEPX). JEPX publishes spot and intraday market prices, traded volumes and area prices of the Japanese wholesale electricity market as downloadable files. Coverage: Japan (nine price areas). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Japan Electric Power Exchange (JEPX)") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support electricity market and capacity-planning studies of Japan. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
